items.quote: As we enter the next fiscal, we will be commissioning four new hospitals, one each in Hyderabad, Kolkata, Bangalore and Gurgaon
items.statement: Commission four new hospitals (Hyderabad, Kolkata, Bangalore, Gurgaon) in FY27
items.speaker: Suneeta Reddy

items.quote: We expect to operationalize roughly half of this capacity in the upcoming fiscal year with the balance coming online early FY '28.
items.statement: Operationalise roughly half of the ~1,500 new beds in FY27, balance early FY28
items.speaker: Suneeta Reddy

items.quote: with the balance coming online early FY '28
items.statement: Balance of the new-hospital capacity online early FY28
items.speaker: Suneeta Reddy

items.quote: we continue to believe that INR150 crore is a good number for now
items.statement: New-hospital ramp-up losses of about INR150 crore for the next year
items.speaker: A. Krishnan

items.quote: As we go into next year, we are hoping that by Q1, we should be operationalizing Hyderabad, the Calcutta facility as well as the Bangalore
items.statement: Hyderabad, Calcutta and Bangalore facilities operational by Q1FY27
items.speaker: A. Krishnan

items.quote: Gurugram would be more like Q2
items.speaker: A. Krishnan

items.quote: So we hope to catch it up in the next quarter.
items.statement: Recover deferred insurance-related revenue in Q4FY26
items.speaker: Madhivanan B.

items.quote: You can expect a consistent growth of around, say, 30% of the GMV for this financial year.
items.statement: GMV growth of about 30% in FY26

items.quote: we have got five more quarters to hit the run rate of about INR25,000 crore
items.statement: Reach an annualised revenue run rate of about INR25,000 crore within five quarters
items.speaker: Sanjiv Gupta

items.quote: On the same-store growth, we expect about 18% and store additions will continue to be in the range of 600 per annum.

items.quote: store additions will continue to be in the range of 600 per annum

items.statement: Open 750 beds in the coming year (FY27)
